driverVariableName.description: Java driver variable name used in extracted snippets; blank defaults to driver

outputDirectory.description: generated project root inside the MCP workspace; blank defaults to generated-tests under the workspace

overwrite.description: whether existing generated source and test-data files may be replaced; status reports are always refreshed; defaults to false

packageName.description: generated Java package; blank defaults to generated.capture

replay.description: whether to compile AND execute the generated test, replay-proving it: true is required for the report status to be SUCCESS (the replay actually passed); false -- or any replay that never runs, e.g. after a compilation failure -- yields codegen-only output the report marks UNCONFIRMED, never SUCCESS; defaults to false

browser.description: Chrome or Edge; blank selects Chrome; WEB/NONE only

codegenOptions.description: full Playwright-codegen-compatible request (viewport, geolocation, HAR, proxy, API capture, etc.); when supplied, its own fields replace targetUrl/browser/outputPath/headless/sessionGoal entirely; WEB/NONE only, absorbs capture_start_codegen

apiCapture.description: whether API network recording is enabled for this session

blockServiceWorkers.description: whether service workers should be blocked

browser.description: Chrome or Edge; blank selects Chrome

channel.description: Chromium channel hint (e.g. chrome, msedge); mapped through SHAFT browser selection

colorScheme.description: preferred color scheme hint (e.g. light or dark)

headless.description: whether to launch without a visible browser window; unspecified defaults to headless per repo policy

ignoreHttpsErrors.description: whether HTTPS certificate errors are ignored

loadStoragePath.description: storage-state input path to restore cookies/local storage from before recording starts

networkOptions.description: network capture filtering options; ignored unless apiCapture is set

outputPath.description: recording/capture JSON output path; blank selects a timestamped recording

saveHarContent.description: HAR body-content emission mode: blank or none (the default) keeps truncated network-trace preview bodies, full emits complete request/response bodies from API-capture's full-body store; opt-in because full bodies are not scrubbed for secrets/PII

saveHarGlob.description: HAR URL glob filter restricting which requests are written to the HAR

saveHarPath.description: HAR output path; blank disables HAR capture

saveStoragePath.description: storage-state output path to persist cookies/local storage to when the session ends

sessionGoal.description: optional user intent for the journey; drives generated test class and method names

targetLanguage.description: requested codegen target language metadata; SHAFT emits fluent Java only (no Python/TypeScript/C# exporters); other values warn and still generate Java

targetUrl.description: initial http, https, or file URL; blank or omitted opens an empty browser at about:blank

testIdAttribute.description: preferred test id attribute (e.g. data-testid); takes priority over SHAFT's default test id attribute list when locating elements

timeoutMillis.description: maximum browser timeout in milliseconds; 0 or unset applies no explicit timeout

userDataDirectory.description: persistent browser profile directory; blank uses a temporary profile

viewportSize.description: viewport size as width,height in pixels (e.g. 1280,720)

headless.description: whether to launch without a visible window; blank/omitted defaults to headless per repo policy; WEB/NONE only

outputPath.description: recording/capture JSON path; blank selects a timestamped recording

sessionGoal.description: optional user intent for the journey; drives generated test class and method names on WEB, or the recorder's mode label on PLAYWRIGHT/mobile

targetUrl.description: initial http, https, or file URL; blank opens an empty browser; WEB/NONE only

targetBrowser.description: browser to launch on the WEB engine; blank/omitted defers to the configured targetBrowserName property (default chrome); PLAYWRIGHT/MOBILE engines resolve their own default independently
